title: Ballistic ion transport through hierarchically-ordered-structure polymer binder
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE06071G, Paper
Defu Li, Chen Fang, Santosh Thapa, Hadas Sternlicht, Gi-Hyeok Lee, Faiz Ahmed, Xiuyu Jin, Qiusu Miao, Raynald Giovine, Wanli Yang, Andrew Minor, Yang-Tse Cheng, Gao Liu
Achieving ballistic ion transport in a mixed electronic-ionic conductive polymer, its hierarchically ordered structure (HOS) facilitates ion diffusion and results in solid-state Li+ conductivity in the range of 10−4 to 10−3 S cm−1 from −20 to 70 °C.
